build_pairwise_lorentzian_inner_product: build a python module to compute pairwise Lorentzian inner product between batches of hyperboloid vectors
build_pairwise_geodesic_distance: build a python module to compute pairwise geodesic distance between batches of points on the hyperboloid
build_exponential_map_to_hyperboloid: build a python module to map Euclidean tangent space vectors onto the hyperboloid using the exponential map
build_logarithmic_map_from_hyperboloid: build a python module to map hyperboloid points back to Euclidean tangent space using the logarithmic map
build_half_aperture_cone_angle: build a python module to compute the half aperture angle of the entailment cone for hyperboloid vectors
